# vstack — Engineering Playbook + OpenCode Runtime + OpenChamber Visualization

> **Summary:** vstack is an engineering playbook and agent workflow ecosystem consisting of three independent components: the vstack Playbook (55 skills, 18 workflows, 17 principles), the vstack OpenCode Plugin (23 tools, 3 agents, 6 stores, 7 gates), and vstack OpenChamber (read-only Panel + Dashboard for workflow visualization).

## Project Overview

vstack provides a portable methodology for AI-assisted software development. It separates concerns across three independent repositories:

- **Playbook** — Defines reusable methodology (skills, workflows, principles) — harness-agnostic, zero runtime code
- **OpenCode Plugin** — Owns authoritative runtime state and publishes projections
- **OpenChamber** — Read-only visualization, consumes projections for Panel + Dashboard

**Version:** vstack-2026.11.03 (v0.1.0)
**Release Date:** 2026-11-03
**License:** MIT
**Repository:** https://github.com/vipintom/vstack-workflow

## Components

### vstack Playbook
- **Package:** `npm:@vipintom/vstack`
- **Repository:** https://github.com/vipintom/vstack-playbook
- **Skills:** 55 across 13 categories (Foundation, Discovery, Architecture, Planning, Verification, Debug/Recovery, Collaboration, Review, Continuity, Delivery, Extended, Implementation, Utils)
- **Workflows:** 18
- **Principles:** 17
- **Harnesses:** OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code

### vstack OpenCode Plugin
- **Package:** `npm:@vipintom/vstack-opencode`
- **Repository:** https://github.com/vipintom/vstack-opencode
- **Tools:** 23 (delivery, history, memory, tasks, agents, checks, sessions)
- **Agents:** 3 (Builder, Reviewer, Lead)
- **Stores:** 6 (delivery, history, memory, quality, tasks, session)
- **Gates:** 7 (verification enforcement)
- **Peer Dependency:** `@opencode/plugin@2.2.0`, `@opencode/schema@2.2.0`

### vstack OpenChamber
- **Distribution:** Git URL or built ZIP
- **Repository:** https://github.com/vipintom/vstack-openchamber
- **Features:** Panel (sidebar), Dashboard (full-page)
- **Requires:** OpenChamber ≥1.24.0, @openchamber/sdk@2.5.3
- **Read-only:** Never mutates runtime state

## Installation

### Playbook Skills (Recommended)
```bash
# OpenCode
opencode skill install vstack

# Codex
codex skill add vstack

# Claude Code
claude skill install vstack
```

### OpenCode Plugin
```bash
npm install @vipintom/vstack-opencode@latest
opencode skill install vstack
```

### OpenChamber Extension
```bash
# Via Extension Manager (recommended)
# OpenChamber Settings → Extensions → Install from URL
# https://github.com/vipintom/vstack-openchamber.git
```

## Architecture

Four independent repositories communicating through versioned projection contracts:

1. **vstack (umbrella)** — Contracts, capability matrix, integrated release metadata
2. **vstack-playbook** — Defines methodology: 55 Skills, 18 Workflows, 17 Principles
3. **vstack-opencode** — Owns runtime state: 23 Tools, 3 Agents, 6 Stores, 7 Gates
4. **vstack-openchamber** — Read-only visualization: Panel + Dashboard

**Shared Project Root:** `.vstack/` — manifest.json, state/, reports/, deliveries/, events.jsonl

## Compatibility

| Component | OpenCode | Codex | Claude Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| Playbook Skills | Full | Full | Full |
| OpenCode Plugin | Full | N/A | N/A |
| OpenChamber | Requires Plugin | N/A | N/A |
